messages:
Alex: Quick weekly snapshot — going to paste a compact headroom + burn forecast by region. please react if something looks off.
Priya: thanks alex. can you call out the >95% zones?
Alex: sure. infra-bot will post the aggregated numbers in 1s.
infra-bot: automated summary: weekly_gpu_hours_requested=148k, weekly_gpu_hours_available=165k, total_headroom=17k (11.5%); high_pressure_zones=[eu-west-1: 92%, us-west-2: 96%].
Jon: us-west-2 at 96% — which clusters specifically?
Alex: short table below (projected peak utilization, Friday 18:00 UTC):
```
region     | cluster          | available_gpus | projected_peak% | spike_headroom_hours
us-west-2  | burst-nv8-pool    | 120            | 96%             | 40h
us-west-2  | steady-nv4         | 80             | 88%             | 100h
eu-west-1  | promo-nv8         | 60             | 92%             | 20h
eu-west-1  | baseline-rtx6000  | 90             | 75%             | 300h
ap-southeast| oncall-nv8        | 50             | 67%             | 200h
```
Marta: that burst-nv8-pool is the one serving Hosted API low-latency; any planned canaries?
Alex: canary scheduled Tue midnight but we can hold if we need to free headroom. Priya, do we want to pause the canary?
Priya: let's pause for this week. push canary to next Tue. :no_entry_sign:
Kim: cost note — if we shift 20 GPUs from steady-nv4 to burst-nv8 temporary, it adds ~ $4.5k/week in committed hours (preemption mix unchanged).
Jon: latency risk if we shift hardware types? any model incompatibilities?
Marta: burst pool runs 8-bit quantized variants for chat-heavy routes, steady is more general. we can replicate 1 node for smoke tests.
Alex: action items: 1) Priya to reschedule canary -> next Tue 0900 PT. 2) Kim to model cost for temporary 20-GPU shift and show 24h vs 72h impact. 3) Jon to run smoke replicate on steady-nv4 tonight.
Priya: noted. I'll update the rollout calendar and set a blocker in the canary ticket.
Kim: I'll run cost sims and post numbers by EOD.
Jon: starting smoke replicate now — posting logs if it flakes.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered by @Jon: replicate/steady-nv4 -> smoke-suite (run id: run-20240312-1145).
Jon: smoke suite looks green so far, 8/8 checks pass, tail latency +4ms. small.
Alex: good. if smoke stays green and Kim's cost is <6k for 72h, we proceed with temporary shift; otherwise we open capacity purchase PR.
Marta: one more note — eu-west-1 promo-nv8 has a scheduled maintenance Fri 02:00 UTC that reduces available_gpus by 10 for 6h. need to include that in forecast.
Alex: thanks. infra-bot, can you append maintenance window to weekly forecast?
infra-bot: maintenance window noted and included; adjusted eu-west-1 projected_peak% -> 95% during Fri 02:00-08:00 UTC.
Priya: marking high-risk window on the status board and pinging customer success for any sensitive customers in eu-west-1.
Alex: OK — let's sync again tomorrow after Kim's numbers. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Marta: thanks.
Kim: will post cost table with scenarios.
Jon: I'll add smoke logs to the ticket.
Alex: thread closed for now, reopen if anything urgent comes up.
